reviews.text: DO NOT GO HERE!! If I could rate this place 0 stars I would ,some of  vets are very nice however pets n vets as a whole I’m convinced they only care about money. My cat underwent a £2,500 surgery which turned out he actually didn’t need also asked if his nails wanted trimmed whilst under to then see that half of them weren’t even done - this happened at the neutering appointment as well with both of my cats! ( eastkilbride branch ) Vet that assessed him initially in Blantyre has actually lied about what I said, I’ve tried to dispute this and the service has been absolutely shocking!!, the vets have actually admitted fault due to miscommunication and have still refused to refund me. My cats will never step foot in this practice again. Joke of a place.

Friendly and welcoming team.
Good attention to my dog Archie.
Staff were great 👍 highly recommend this vet …
My dog Charlie attends this vets and she is really looked after.
Staff were great with Rocky from entering to leaving the three staff members on duty were all over him and making sure he was calm the whole time
Friendly, knowledgeable staff. The vet was great as regards advice, ways forward and was honest in what she said. Not just money oriented. Will use again

My dog was seen and a potentially life threatening condition (pyometra) was missed. I was made to feel as if I was overreacting when I visited and asked for an urgent appointment. My dog had a quick check from the vet in the waiting room and told she was ok. I know my own dog and knew there was something seriously wrong. Lucky we trusted our gut and got a second opinion.

She had emergency surgery at the Roundhouse in Glasgow later that night. She Is now recovery well from shoe surgery. I will be changing vet’s. Have lost all faith in Pet’n’Vets.

I’ve moved into the area and couldn’t be happier that my cat is being looked after at this practice. Just routine vaccinations on this occasion but everyone (from receptionists to Vets) has been so helpful and friendly, I feel confident that if I need to call on the team for Hobbes future care that he’s in safe hands.
Fantastic vets. Completely professional, knowledgeable and very approachable.
Always make our dog feel welcome even though he’s not a big fan of other dogs. Friendly, understanding service with the backing of a local network of other surgeries
Fantastic doctor.  My dog is very happy!!! Thanks
Amazing, Kind, Friendly staff that will listen and then explain clearly

The best vet ever!  The staff are polite, warm and welcoming.  Despite isla being a loud barker, protesting being in the clinic amd mostly needing 2 people to hold her still for injections or inspection!  I wouldn’t go anywhere else ⭐️
Freindly staff

I have been using this vets for years now. If has always been a good experience for us, with knowledgeable vets treating my pets quickly and efficiently

Our wee dog has been very ill this year, but with the greatest care  attention and medical intervention, she is currently doing well with a good quality of life. The whole Blantyre team ,receptionists nurses, and vets look after her and us too. They support us emotionally and help make this difficult time a bit easier. Always there when we need them for help or advice. We would find it very much more difficult without them and thankyou is just not a sufficient way to express our gratitude.
Great practice, very friendly and helpful staff.
